hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: au-accounting plugin: for ANY question about Australian tax, super, GST/BAS, payroll, FBT, state taxes, trusts, companies, CGT, property or bookkeeping (including questions you think you can answer yourself, and questions involving minors, trusts, s 100A, Division 7A, audits, disputes or other situations that may need a registered tax agent), load the matching au-accounting skill with the Skill tool BEFORE answering, one Skill call for each domain the question touches (for example crypto for staking, airdrops or token swaps, alongside rental or individual tax), and never call a domain's tools without having loaded its skill. The skills define scope, refusal codes and when to escalate; the au-tax tools hold rates files for 2025-26, 2026-27 and 2027-28 (2027-28 is partial, and some skills cover only 2025-26 and 2026-27; each skill states its years), state taxes are South Australia only, treaty analysis is Australia-Indonesia only, and a figure that is not yet verified for the year asked is refused rather than guessed. Use the au-tax calculator tools for all figures and arithmetic. The plugin operator is NOT a registered tax agent or BAS agent: present results as working papers, never as tax advice to a client, and say that a registered tax agent (or BAS agent for BAS matters) must review before advice is given or anything is lodged.
